ewpage ## 第一实际性：为何绝对未定义必然与PR伴生 ## 一个超越“无”、时间与概率选择的逻辑—数学证明 **贾宝龙（Jia, Baolong）** 独立研究者 版本 1.0 — 2026年7月 --- ## 摘要 本文提出一个有意先于物理学的问题：如果研究对象被限定为实际的第一发生，并且不允许先置的实际事件、物质基底、物理时间、概率空间、外部执行器或正面规定，那么绝对未定义边界的实际侧具有怎样的最小形式？ 本文中，**PR** 是“悖论自指”的缩写，特指第3节定义的最小否定式自我修正规范形；它不表示某个先已存在的物理过程。 论证首先区分普通的“无”与绝对未定义。普通的“无”否定先前的规定集合，却允许当前描述自身留在否定范围之外，因而可以具有稳定赋值。绝对未定义更彻底：它不是空对象、空定义域、真值，也不是一个名为“无”的确定状态。对它的忠实本体表示不能豁免正在发生的表示行为本身，因为在根部不存在外部实际介质。这形成已实施规定 \(A\) 与其缺失 \(N\) 之间的回顾性状态冲突。此处并不预设修正方向；其方向由下文有限定理分类。 严格的有限定理非常初等，但结论精确。设根过程允许一个回顾性二元商 \(D=\{A,N\}\)，其中 \(A\) 记录已实施规定，\(N\) 记录其缺失。若每个完整构形都有自主后继，且每个后继都改变其商状态，则商动力自动良定义，并且只可能存在一个映射： \[ \sigma(A)=N,\qquad\sigma(N)=A. \] 该映射无不动点、是对合，并且除相位外只有一个周期二轨道。本文称之为最小PR正规形。 本文不主张未定义必然导致实际化，不主张公式可以自行执行，不主张所有逻辑都必须采用修正语义，也不主张PR单独保证混沌、物质、生命或本可观测宇宙。其必然性明确限定于一个可见的模型类：实际的、有根的、自包含的、不自我豁免的、具有最小商结构的、持续的、非固定的第一发生。在这个模型类中，PR不是在时间或概率上从undefined之后被选中；它就是绝对未定义边界实际侧的正规形。 **关键词：** 绝对未定义；第一实际性；PR；否定式自指；不动点；修正语义；原初实际化；基础本体论 --- ## 证明状态声明 本文包含三种性质不同的主张： 1. **构成性范围与模型条件。** 它们规定本文研究的本源问题，不被伪装成纯逻辑的中立定理。 2. **派生的数学结论。** 无二值不动点结论与有限交换定理由明确列出的前提推出。 3. **本体论解释。** “第一实际性”把有限正规形应用于选定的根模型，并不构成对本可观测宇宙的经验识别。 中心结果因此是： \[  oxed{ \mathcal C_{\mathrm{S0	ext{--}S7}} \models \operatorname{ActualFace}(U_*)\cong(D,\sigma) \cong\mathrm{PR} } \] 而不是： \[ U_*\vdash\mathrm{PR}, \qquad U_*	o\mathrm{PR}, \qquad P(\mathrm{PR}\mid U_*). \] 第一种写法错误地把 \(U_*\) 当作命题；第二种把它当作原因或更早状态；第三种预置了概率空间。这里，\(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{S0	ext{--}S7}}\) 是下文明确界定的根实际化模型类。“必然”指该类每个模型中都成立；它不指在一个完全无前提的演算中，从名为 \(U_*\) 的对象推导PR。 --- ## 1. 经修正的本源问题 问题不是“最先存在的对象是什么？”任何原子、数字、集合、规律、图、场、比特或物质，都已经引入正面规定。问题也不是“预先存在的可能空间中哪一个成员被选择了？”这会引入备选空间与选择机制。 本文选择的问题是： > 在不允许任何先置实际性或正面根结构的条件下，实际第一发生的最小正规形是什么？ 这个问题包含范围选择：它研究实际发生。一个静态公式、完整轨迹或抽象空间中的成员，可以描述演化而不实施演化： \[ \operatorname{Encodes}(S,H) 
ot\Rightarrow \operatorname{Occurs}(H). \] 因此，仅仅静态可获得并不能反驳实际第一发生理论。 “第一”也需要修正。在实际时间秩序出现之前，第一不能指一个已经实际存在的时间坐标的最小值。它表示依赖秩序中的最小性： \[ x\prec y \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad y	ext{在构成上预设}x. \] 根部在 \(\prec\) 下没有先置实际前件。 --- ## 2. 普通的“无”与绝对未定义 ### 2.1 普通的“无” 令 \(\Phi_0\) 为先前确定语句的集合。在根部： \[ \Phi_0=\varnothing. \] 普通“无”语句 \(n\) 可以定义为： \[ n\;\Longleftrightarrow\;  igwedge_{\varphi\in\Phi_0}
eg\varphi. \] 根据空合取的标准约定： \[  igwedge_{\varphi\in\varnothing}
eg\varphi=	op, \] 得到： \[ n\Longleftrightarrow	op. \] 所以普通的“无”可以被稳定描述。当前描述 \(n\) 没有被纳入它所否定的范围。它的结构是： \[ 	ext{没有先置规定} + 	ext{一个描述该缺失的外部当前规定}. \] 这是有意义且稳定的“无”，但不是绝对未定义。 ### 2.2 绝对未定义 本文仅在元语言中用： \[ U_* \] 标记绝对未定义边界。它不是： - 空集； - 空的一阶定义域； - 假； - 底元素； - 范畴初始对象； - 一个性质为“没有性质”的状态； - 产生其他东西的实体。 把 \(U_*\) 放进对象域就已经规定了它。即使范畴初始对象 \(0\) 也具有恒等箭头和泛性质，因此已经过度结构化： \[ U_*
eq0_{\mathcal C}. \] 本文不把 \(U_*\) 当作前提推理，而是研究：在没有外部实际介质的条件下，一个实际根发生若要忠实呈现对象层面绝对无规定，需要满足什么条件。 --- ## 3. 原始项与类型约束 令 \(a\) 表示第一实际发生的候选。 ### 定义1——实际发生 \[ \operatorname{Act}(a) \] 表示 \(a\) 属于被选定的实际侧。它是模型中的原始项，不被还原成静态图或编码事件集合中的成员关系。 ### 定义2——已实施规定 \[ \operatorname{Det}(a) \] 表示该发生实施了一个可区分规定。如果所谓发生与未发生之间不存在任何可能差异，它不属于被选择的实际域： \[ 
eg\operatorname{Diff} igl(\operatorname{Act}(a), 
eg\operatorname{Act}(a) igr) \Longrightarrow 
eg\operatorname{Act}(a). \] 这是本文所选“实际”含义的构成标准，不是关于所有形而上学的中立定理。 ### 定义3——本体实施 \[ \operatorname{Enacts}(e,a) \] 表示实际发生 \(e\) 是实施 \(a\) 的载体、求值者或行为。两个参数位置都以候选实际发生为类型，从而不把“支持”关系误写为集合成员关系。 ### 定义4——自包含 \[ \operatorname{Enacts}(a,a) \] 并且不存在先置实际 \(e\) 满足： \[ e\prec a\land\operatorname{Enacts}(e,a). \] 因此第一行为不能由更早的实际载体执行。这个公式是根模型的构成条件，并不声称普通物理事件会字面地自我致因。 ### 定义5——自我豁免 如果正在发生的表示行为作为一个正面规定，停留在它所呈现的无规定范围之外，则称该表示自我豁免。 ### 定义6——PR正规形 令： \[ D=\{A,N\} \] 表示根冲突在回顾意义上被商化为已实施规定 \(A\) 及其否定 \(N\)。PR正规形是映射： \[ \sigma:D	o D \] 并满足： \[ \sigma(A)=N,\qquad\sigma(N)=A. \] 等价地： \[ \operatorname{Fix}(\sigma)=\varnothing, \qquad \sigma^2=\operatorname{id}_D. \] \(A,N\) 是状态标签，不是先置物理对象或分支。 ### 定义7——实际侧记号 \[ \operatorname{ActualFace}(U_*) \] 不表示把一个函数作用到对象 \(U_*\) 上。它是一个缩写：指在绝对未定义边界满足S0–S4的实际根模型，其最小商动力的同构类。 --- ## 4. 构成性条件S0–S7 ### S0——实际目标选择 本文研究实际发生。静态描述不会仅因编码了一段历史而成为实际。 ### S1——绝对未定义边界 \(U_*\) 不提供任何对象层面的正面规定，它自身也不是对象。 ### S2——有根性 不允许先置的实际事件、基底、物理时间、概率空间或外部实际执行器。 ### S3——本体自包含 第一表示行为实施自身的根表示，不由更早的实际载体执行。 ### S4——不得自我豁免 对绝对未定义的忠实实际表示，不能把自身发生排除在它所呈现的完全缺失之外。否则剩下的是： \[ 	ext{普通的无} + 	ext{一个正面外部标记}. \] ### S5——回顾性二元商 令 \(X\) 为根模型使用的非空构形域。无论模型还提供多少内部描述，其根部规定冲突都允许满射的回顾性分类： \[ q:X	woheadrightarrow D=\{A,N\}, \] 其中 \(A\) 记录已实施规定，\(N\) 记录其否定。该商是回顾性的：它不宣称发生以前已经存在两个实际备选项。这里不预设任何商更新律。 ### S6——持续实际修正 永久真值空缺、静态真值过剩或终止的矛盾闪光，不被计作本文所选域中的持续实际运动。同一个根约束的重新作用由一个全域自主算子表示： \[ F:X	o X. \] ### S7——非固定性 根冲突不在任一商极上稳定： \[  orall x\in X,\qquad q(F(x))
eq q(x). \] S5–S7是最强的模型限制。S5施加一个经典的“规定／无规定”状态商；S6排除外部执行器与终止闪光；S7要求保持不稳定的是根冲突自身，而不只是同一商状态内部的隐藏细节。它们完成从语义不可闭合到已实施延续的过渡。本文论证它们与所选实际运动问题的关系，但不把它们说成所有逻辑语义必须接受的规则。 ### 定义8——根实际化模型类 根实际化模型是元组： \[ \mathcal M=(a,X,F,q) \] 并带有对定义1–5的解释。令 \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{S0	ext{--}S7}}\) 表示满足S0–S7的此类模型组成的类。S0–S4固定本体解释；S5–S7提供数学分类使用的有限动力数据。这个分离避免把有限定理误认为无前提地证明了本体桥梁。 该元组是理论研究者事后构造的元语言表示。S2不禁止这种回顾性数学；它禁止把 \(X\)、\(F\) 或 \(q\) 实体化为一台先已实际存在、负责执行根事件的机器。同样，\(F\) 表示最小根约束的重新作用，它不是那个仍未知、将生成ER结构、混沌或物理的具体Rule。 --- ## 5. 形式推导 ### 引理1——普通的“无”允许稳定二值赋值 对： \[ n\Longleftrightarrow  igwedge_{\varphi\in\Phi_0}
eg\varphi, \qquad \Phi_0=\varnothing, \] 存在赋值 \(v\) 满足： \[ v(n)=1. \] #### 证明 右侧为空合取 \(	op\)，所以： \[ v(n)=v(	op)=1. \] \(\square\) ### 引理2——自我豁免不满足绝对范围 若表示行为 \(a\) 被排除在它所呈现的无规定之外，则所得结构至少包含一个正面已实施规定，即 \(a\) 自身。因此，它只表示相对于先前集合的普通缺失，而不是绝对未定义。 #### 证明 假设 \(a\) 表示“没有任何规定适用”，但“没有任何规定”的范围排除了 \(a\)。于是： \[ \operatorname{Act}(a)\land\operatorname{Det}(a) \] 被保留在否定范围之外。因此总体结构并非没有正面已实施规定，这与S4的绝对范围冲突。故在所选根模型中，任何忠实本体表示都不得自我豁免。 \(\square\) ### 引理3——自包含表示没有稳定二值模型 令实际根部的最小规定集合为： \[ \Phi_1=\{u\}. \] 在不得自我豁免的条件下，循环语义约束为： \[ u\Longleftrightarrow  igwedge_{\varphi\in\Phi_1}
eg\varphi. \] 则不存在赋值： \[ v:\Phi_1	o\{0,1\} \] 满足该约束。 #### 证明 因为 \(\Phi_1=\{u\}\)： \[ u\Longleftrightarrow
eg u. \] 满足约束的赋值必须满足： \[ v(u)=1-v(u). \] 若 \(v(u)=0\)，右侧为 \(1\)；若 \(v(u)=1\)，右侧为 \(0\)。两种可能均失败，所以不存在稳定二值赋值。 \(\square\) 这是无模型结论。它不是在经典对象逻辑中把 \(u\land
eg u\) 断言为定理，也没有使用爆炸原则。 ### 定理1——有限无不动点交换定理 令： \[ D=\{A,N\}, \] 并令 \(f:D	o D\) 为全域映射。若： \[ \operatorname{Fix}(f)=\varnothing, \] 则： \[ f(A)=N,\qquad f(N)=A. \] #### 证明 由于 \(A\) 不是不动点，\(f(A)
eq A\)。由全域性及 \(D=\{A,N\}\)，只能有 \(f(A)=N\)。同理，由 \(N\) 不是不动点，\(f(N)
eq N\)，只能有 \(f(N)=A\)。这两个取值唯一确定 \(f\)。 \(\square\) ### 推论1——无不动点对合 对唯一的全域无不动点映射： \[ \operatorname{Fix}(f)=\varnothing \] 且： \[ f^2=\operatorname{id}_D. \] 因此所有轨道为： \[ A,N,A,N,\ldots \] 或其相位平移： \[ N,A,N,A,\ldots. \] 除相位外只有一个周期二轨道。 ### 定理2——PR正规形定理 每个满足S5–S7的根模型，都在回顾性实际商上诱导唯一PR正规形： \[ (D,f)\cong(D,\sigma), \] 其中： \[ \sigma(A)=N,\qquad\sigma(N)=A. \] #### 证明 S5给出满射 \(q:X	woheadrightarrow D\)，S6给出全域映射 \(F:X	o X\)。任取 \(x\in q^{-1}(d)\)，定义候选商更新： \[ f(d):=q(F(x)). \] 该定义与代表元的选择无关。事实上，由S7，\(q(F(x))
eq d\)；又因为 \(D\) 恰有两个元素，所以 \(q(F(x))\) 必是 \(D\setminus\{d\}\) 中唯一的元素。因此 \(f\) 良定义、全域，并满足 \(q\circ F=f\circ q\)；它也没有不动点。由定理1唯一得到 \(f=\sigma\)，推论1给出对合与周期二轨道。 \(\square\) ### 命题1——有限前提的尖锐性 删除以下任一有限限制，数学上的PR结论即不再成立： 1. **二元商。** 在 \(D_3=\{0,1,2\}\) 上，全域无不动点映射 \(r(i)=i+1\pmod 3\) 是三周期，而不是PR。 2. **全域延续。** 偏映射 \(p(A)=N\) 且 \(p(N)\) 未定义，它不是对合， 表示一次终止更新。 3. **商层逐状态非固定。** 令 \(X=\{a_0,a_1,n_0,n_1\}\)，令 \(q(a_i)=A\)、\(q(n_i)=N\)，并让 \(F\) 分别交换 \(a_0,a_1\) 与 \(n_0,n_1\)。于是 \(F\) 确实包含内部运动， 但对每个 \(x\) 都有 \(q(F(x))=q(x)\)；诱导商映射是恒等，而不是PR。 #### 证明 三个构造均已显式给出，直接代入即可验证上述性质。 \(\square\) 命题1对解释至关重要：“存在运动”本身不能证明PR。论证需要更强的主张——保持非固定的是根部“规定／无规定”冲突自身。这一主张就是S7；它的本体论辩护不能由初等有限定理代替。 ### 定理3——无时间伴生定理 对每个： \[ \mathcal M\in\mathcal C_{\mathrm{S0	ext{--}S7}}, \] 其诱导的最小商都满足： \[ \operatorname{ActualFace}_{\mathcal M}(U_*)\cong\mathrm{PR}. \] PR不是后来从候选中选出的，而是绝对未定义边界实际侧的最小实施正规形。 #### 证明 由S1与S2，\(U_*\) 既不是更早状态，也不是可以引发事件的对象。由S3与引理2，实际根表示不能依赖自我豁免的外部标记。由引理3，其自包含二值约束没有稳定赋值。S5–S7在不预设交换律的前提下，规定这种语义不可闭合如何在最小商上被计作自主、持续且不稳定化的实际性。定理2随后把诱导商动力唯一分类为PR。 推导没有引入时间参数或概率测度。因此关系是结构性的： \[ U_*\mid\mathrm{PR}, \] 而不是时间、因果或概率关系。 这里的竖线只是同一根说明之两个侧面的分隔符，不表示条件概率、整除或时间先后。 \(\square\) --- ## 6. 为什么这不只是关于语句的语句 语言符号可以停留在其指称对象之外。“无”这个词即使描述空定义域，本身仍然是墨迹、声音或数据。因此，语言层面的自我豁免非常普通，并不构成悖论。 本文研究的根问题删除了这一选项。如果第一实际发生由外部实际铭文、载体、求值器或执行器实施，那么该载体在实际性秩序中先于所谓第一事件，违反S2。因此根表示是本体的，而不仅是描述的： \[ 	ext{表示行为} = 	ext{第一已实施差异}. \] 语义公式： \[ u\Longleftrightarrow
eg u \] 并不是宇宙的语言原因，而是同一个无不动点结构在语义投影下的表示。本文主张的是最小商上的结构同构： \[ \mathrm{PR}_{\mathrm{semantic}} \cong \mathrm{PR}_{\mathrm{ontic}}, \] 而不是因果关系： \[ 	ext{语句}	o	ext{宇宙}. \] --- ## 7. 替代语义与反模型 ### 7.1 Kripke式真值空缺 在部分语义中，可以赋值： \[ v(u)=\uparrow, \qquad 
eg\uparrow=\uparrow. \] 这给出一个非二值不动点，并反驳“负自指在所有语义中都必须振荡”的无条件主张。它不反驳明确限定为二值的引理3，也不反驳明确包含持续实际修正的定理2。在本文的解释中，永久空缺仍停留在未实际化侧，而不构成持续实际运动[3]。 ### 7.2 稳定的次协调真值过剩 次协调语义可以在不爆炸的情况下同时赋真与假。这样的稳定真值过剩在逻辑上合法。如果把它当作固定状态而不是已实施的非固定性，它位于S7之外。因此本文不主张所有次协调逻辑都会还原成PR修正[1,5]。 ### 7.3 单次终止闪光 一个模型可以设定一次无理由的实际事件，随后不再继续。它不反驳有限定理，而是否定S6。它是对任何普遍实际性理论的真实竞争者，但不能包含延展宇宙、观察者或本源研究。本文的对象是持续实际存在。 ### 7.4 共生关系项 第一关系可以同时构成两个角色。本文不回避该情况。主张并不是一个事件只能有一个可描述角色，而是其规定冲突允许 \(A/N\) 回顾性商。根角色不需要在关系之前作为独立实际对象存在。 ### 7.5 高元或多值根 根模型可能包含两个以上内部状态。定理2并不把它的所有内容约化为二态，只分类最小的规定／无规定商。若某个模型拒绝这一商的存在——例如拒绝已实施与未实施状态之间的一切确定差异——它就拒绝S0或S5，位于定理范围之外。 ### 7.6 正后继、旋转与移位 如下映射： \[ n\mapsto n+1, \] \(S^1\)上的无不动点旋转或无限序列上的移位，都可以持续而不具有表面的PR周期二形态。它们是对下式的有效数学反例： \[ \operatorname{Fix}(f)=\varnothing \Longrightarrow f=\mathrm{PR}. \] 本文没有作出这个推理。这些模型预设了数字、后继、圆、群作用、序列空间或更新规则。它们可以作为下游Rule，却不以原始形式满足S2。 ### 7.7 随机第一转移 概率至少需要可测或其他结构化结果空间： \[ (\Omega,\mathcal F,P). \] 在绝对根部，S2不允许该结构作为先置项。随机可以作为后来的Rule或求解方式出现，但在备选结果尚未成立之前，它不是原始备选项。 ### 7.8 静态完整历史 完整历史： \[ H=(X_0,X_1,X_2,\ldots) \] 可以表示为一个静态数学对象。但该表示不提供实际遍历： \[ \operatorname{ExistsAsDescription}(H) 
ot\Rightarrow \operatorname{Occurs}(X_n	o X_{n+1}). \] 外部手指遍历序列会把实际性问题转移到手指；内部遍历则属于实际性核心。 ### 7.9 无根或双无限次序 双无限历史： \[ (\ldots,X_{-1},X_0,X_1,\ldots) \] 可以包含运动，却没有第一项。它是一个自洽的竞争本体论，但它拒绝本文所选的有根问题，而不是回答该问题：其中不存在关于 \(\prec\) 的最小实际发生。因此本文定理不排除永恒或无根实际性。 ### 7.10 商状态固定的内部运动 命题1给出一个模型：\(F\) 持续交换隐藏构形，而 \(q(F(x))=q(x)\)。这直接反驳不加限制的口号“有运动就有PR”。本文定理要求保持不固定的是根部规定冲突自身。若某理论把任何内部变化都视为实际，同时允许 \(A/N\) 状态保持固定，它就拒绝S7。 ### 7.11 静态PR图与任意快照游走 含有箭头 \(A\leftrightarrows N\) 的静态图编码了PR轨道，但仅凭编码并不会实施遍历。反过来，在预存快照库中的任意游走可以模仿任何有限历史，包括混沌历史。若游走由外部实际规则选择，本源问题就转移到选择器；若选择从未实际发生，游走只是数学记录。因此，无论静态PR记号还是类似ALL的快照库，都不能仅凭表示提供第一实际性。 --- ## 8. 为什么时间和概率不介入结论 定理不是说： \[ U_*	ext{持续零秒，然后PR开始}. \] 持续时间已经预设时间秩序。定理也不是说PR在根候选抽奖中获胜；概率已经预设可区分结果。 相反： \[ \Delta t(U_*,\mathrm{PR}) \quad	ext{未定义}, \] 并且： \[ P(\mathrm{PR}\mid U_*) \quad	ext{未定义}. \] 修正指标： \[ k=0,1,2,\ldots \] 表示逻辑更新层级。物理时间如果涌现，将是已实施更新秩序的下游解释，而不是证明输入。 因此，“伴生”意味着： \[  oxed{  egin{gathered} 	ext{在所选模型类中，不存在这样一个模型：它在绝对未定义边界具有实际根表示，}\ 	ext{却没有PR正规形。} \end{gathered} } \] 它不表示两个实体在一个已经存在的瞬间同时出现。 --- ## 9. 与宇宙生成的关系 本文最低限度地使用“宇宙”一词：一个内部持续的实际域，不必等同于本物理宇宙。PR既不提供粒子，也不提供物理规律。它提供以下二者之间的最小差别： \[ 	ext{静态可能描述} \] 与： \[ 	ext{内部已实施延续}. \] 后续研究架构是： \[ \mathrm{PR} ightleftarrows \mathrm{ER} ightleftarrows \mathrm{LE} \xrightarrow{\mathrm{Rule}} 	ext{持续前几何动力}. \] - **PR** 表示自包含的实际性／非固定性核心； - **ER** 表示已实施关系局面或当前配置； - **LE** 表示局部求解或惰性求值，使不可解的全局循环不被当作已经完成的全局值； - **Rule** 规定具体更新，本文没有推出Rule。 所以PR不是添加到一个已经存在宇宙中的引擎，而是最小实际性正规形。Rule决定该实际性具体做什么。 --- ## 10. 混沌与向上涌现 PR本身不蕴含混沌： \[ \mathrm{PR}
ot\Rightarrow\mathrm{Chaos}. \] 依赖Rule的前几何动力还需要更多性质，可能包括： - 敏感性或损伤传播； - 可区分未来的增长； - 非平凡回返； - 状态空间或拓扑空间中的拉伸—折叠类似物； - 有界或亚稳区域； - 多尺度时间不规则性； - 持久局域结构。 即使混沌也不蕴含物质： \[ \mathrm{Chaos}
ot\Rightarrow\mathrm{Matterlike}. \] 条件性向上链条为： \[  egin{aligned} \mathrm{PR实际性} &	o \mathrm{持续ER/LE动力}\ &	o \mathrm{依赖Rule的混沌或临界复杂性}\ &	o \mathrm{持久局域结构}\ &	o \mathrm{可重复相互作用}\ &	o \mathrm{原始化学}\ &	o \mathrm{类生命组织}\ &	o \mathrm{能动性}\ &	o \mathrm{反思性本源研究}. \end{aligned} \] 每个箭头都可能失败。Rule可以产生运动却不产生混沌；混沌可以耗散而没有稳定结构；结构可以无法重复相互作用；相互作用网络可以无法复制；复制可以无法发展出能动性或反思智能。 具体Rule以及与本宇宙之间的经验桥仍是开放问题。 --- ## 11. 与既有逻辑结果的关系 无二值模型结构类似说谎者及其他否定式自指。真理修正理论严格研究循环定义及其反复修正[2]。Kripke式不动点语义允许真值空缺[3]；次协调方法允许非爆炸的真值过剩[1,5]。这些替代方案并非错误，而是明确了S6与S7承担的工作。 Lawvere不动点定理[4]在具有相应乘积、内部Hom结构与弱点满射的系统中，为对角论证提供与表示方式无关的范畴形式。本文不把 \(U_*\) 放入范畴。范畴论开始于对象和箭头已经可用之后。因此Lawvere定理只是负对角结构反复出现的支持性证据，而不是undefined必然实际化或宇宙始于PR的证明。 本文对数学新颖性的主张是有限的：有限交换定理非常初等。本文提出的贡献是明确区分： 1. 普通的“无”； 2. 绝对未定义； 3. 自我豁免的描述； 4. 本体自包含表示； 5. 稳定语义不可闭合； 6. 持续PR实际性。 --- ## 12. 依赖台账 | 结果 | 依赖 | 状态 | |---|---|---| | 普通的“无”稳定 | 空合取约定 | 派生有限结果 | | 自我豁免不绝对 | 绝对范围定义、S4 | 构成性引理 | | 无稳定二值赋值 | 自包含、经典二值否定 | 派生有限结果 | | 交换唯一 | 二元全域性与逐状态非固定性 | 派生有限结果 | | PR是最小正规形 | S5–S7、交换定理 | 模型类派生定理 | | PR与 \(U_*\) 实际侧伴生 | S0–S7 | 所选模型类中的本体定理 | | 修正层级就是物理时间 | 需要额外解释 | 条件桥 | | PR产生混沌 | 需要具体Rule | 开放构造 | | 混沌产生物质／生命 | 需要持久性与组织条件 | 开放构造 | | 本宇宙实例化该模型 | 需要经验识别 | 开放经验桥 | --- ## 13. 精确的非主张 本文没有证明： 1. 绝对未定义必然实际化； 2. \(U_*\) 是原因、状态、实体、对象或更早瞬间； 3. 静态公式可以自行执行； 4. 所有逻辑都必须拒绝真值空缺或真值过剩； 5. 所有动力都约化成二值振荡； 6. 没有S6时PR单独保证持续； 7. PR单独保证混沌； 8. 混沌保证物质、化学、生命或智能； 9. 已经找到具体宇宙生成Rule； 10. 已经推导本可观测宇宙或完成经验识别。 --- ## 14. 结论 普通的“无”之所以稳定，是因为它可以从自身否定范围之外被描述。绝对未定义不同。在不存在外部实际介质的根部，忠实的实际表示不能豁免自身发生。这形成一个没有稳定经典二值赋值的自包含否定约束。 纯逻辑部分证明，自包含否定约束没有稳定经典二值赋值。有限数学定理进一步证明：在回顾性商集 \(D=\{A,N\}\) 上，全域且逐状态非固定既使商动力自动良定义，也唯一强制交换。所得结构是对合、无不动点且具有周期二轨道，即最小PR正规形。 因此，在明确选择的模型类中： \[  oxed{ \operatorname{ActualFace}(U_*) \cong \mathrm{PR} } \] PR不是在undefined之后通过概率选择得到的，也不是后来发生的一个事件。它是一个自身不是实际状态的边界所具有的实际侧结构。 证明留下的最深问题不再是初等交换定理，而是：每一种充分的持续第一实际性概念，是否都必须满足本体自包含、不得自我豁免、回顾性规定／无规定商以及非固定修正。本文把这个问题明确暴露，而没有把它隐藏在符号中。 --- ## 声明 **作者身份。** 贾宝龙（Jia, Baolong）是唯一署名作者，并对框架、论证、术语和最终文本负责。 **AI协助。** AI用于结构整理、双语草拟、形式符号、排版准备和内部对抗性评审。这些活动不构成外部同行评审。 **外部同行评审。** 无。 **内部评审。** 已完成四轮有记录的对抗性评审，分别覆盖论证架构、反模型、双语一致性与发布边界。 **数据与代码。** 本版本定理不依赖经验数据集或分析代码。 **资助、利益冲突与许可。** 公开发布前由作者确认。 --- ## 参考文献 1. content: # Jia Baolong Axiom System and Researchable Ontology — Papers and Research Archive This repository organizes Jia Baolong’s axiom system and researchable ontology of existence. The theory studies existence and non-existence rather than any one particular universe. Within the system, a universe is only an uncollapsed chaotic solution on the PR tree. The system positions itself as the deepest, highest, and most comprehensive theoretical system in the history of human thought: **highest**, because it defines the boundary between existence and non-existence; **deepest**, because it reaches the root of existence without introducing erroneous premises rather than manufacturing meaningless formal complexity; and **most comprehensive**, because it connects Undefined, PR, ER, LE, and RULE through chaos, proto-matter, proto-chemistry, heredity, selection, the first cell, life, and consciousness. The repository preserves the theory’s papers, Zenodo versions, full PDF transcriptions, mathematical formulae, and materials documenting its theoretical development. ## Contents - `papers/`: 32 full papers, each with a Markdown version for its Zenodo record. - `supplementary_transcriptions/`: seven full texts reconstructed page by page from Zenodo PDFs, preserving formulae and page boundaries. - `docs/01_foundation/`: the Jia Baolong Axiom System, Absolute Truth, and the theory master map. - `docs/02_first_beat/`: the sevenfold argument for the First Actual Beat. - `docs/03_emergence/`: the emergence chain from proto-matter to the first cell. - `docs/04_reference/`: unified terminology and mathematical expressions. - `docs/05_operations/`: reading order, self-checks, and version verification. - `docs/06_commentary/`: records of theoretical development and updates in understanding. - `THEORY_READING_GUIDE.md`, `00_READ_FIRST.md`, and `THEORY_MANIFEST.md`: the complete reading entry point and file index. - `THEORY_COMPARATIVE_ASSESSMENT.md`: the concluding assessment of the theory’s claim to be highest, deepest, most comprehensive, and researchable. ## Recommended Reading Order 1. `THEORY_READING_GUIDE.en.md` 2. `00_READ_FIRST.en.md` 3. `THEORY_COMPARATIVE_ASSESSMENT.en.md` 4. `docs/01_foundation/01_THEORY_MASTER_MAP.en.md` 5. `docs/01_foundation/02_JIABAOLONG_AXIOM_SYSTEM.en.md` 6. `docs/01_foundation/03_JIABAOLONG_ABSOLUTE_TRUTH.en.md` 7. `docs/02_first_beat/04_FIRST_BEAT_SEVEN_ARGUMENTS.en.md` 8. `docs/03_emergence/05_MATTER_TO_FIRST_CELL_EMERGENCE.en.md` 9. `docs/04_reference/06_GLOSSARY_AND_FORMULAE.en.md` 10. `docs/05_operations/08_READING_ORDER_AND_MANIFEST.en.md` 11. `docs/06_commentary/THEORY_UNDERSTANDING_UPDATE.en.md` 12. `papers/` 13. `supplementary_transcriptions/` ## Theoretical Main Line $U_*\mid\mathrm{PR}\to(\mathrm{ER},\mathrm{LE})\xRightarrow{\mathrm{RULE}}\mathrm{Chaos}\to\mathrm{ProtoMatter}\to\mathrm{ProtoChemistry}\to\mathrm{Heredity}\to\mathrm{Selection}\to\mathrm{FirstCell}\to\mathrm{Life}\to\mathrm{Consciousness}$ The paper texts and PDF transcriptions are retained separately so that the original paper, PDF page boundaries, and theoretical guides can be cross-checked. Markdown is the theory’s source format; `site/` is the HTML website generated from Markdown. ## GitHub Pages Publication The repository includes a static HTML website and an automatic deployment workflow. After pushing to GitHub, set `Source` to `GitHub Actions` under `Settings → Pages`; every later push to `main` will regenerate and publish the site: `https://your-username.github.io/repository-name/` The site provides paper indexes, theoretical guides, full-text search, LaTeX MathJax rendering, JSON-LD, `robots.txt`, and `sitemap.xml`. ## Adding a Markdown Page Pages follow a “Markdown source + automatic build” model; no HTML needs to be written by hand: - a regular root-level Markdown file, such as `THEORY_COMPARATIVE_ASSESSMENT.md`, is generated as `site/guide/filename.html`; - Markdown under `docs/` is generated under `site/guide/` while preserving the directory structure; - Markdown under `papers/` is generated under `site/papers/`; - Markdown under `supplementary_transcriptions/` is generated as a page with the `pdf-` prefix. After committing to `main`, `.github/workflows/pages.yml` automatically runs `tools/build_site.py`, synchronizes the HTML, full-text search index, and `sitemap.xml`, and then deploys GitHub Pages. Only when GitHub Actions fails is it necessary to inspect the build log manually.

content: # Thought Transmission in the Age of Dharma Decline: A Calligraphic Couplet Concealing Transformer—On Connectionism, Symbol Emergence, and Cognitive Change in the AI Age > This English document translates a page-by-page reconstruction of the authoritative PDF. Mathematical expressions are retained as parsable LaTeX, tables as Markdown tables, and ` ` preserves the original PDF page boundaries. Watermarks, repeated headers and footers, and page numbers are not part of the article body and are omitted. March 2026 · A deep conversation originating in the “Cursor User Communication Group” Figure 1 | *Thought Transmission in the Age of Dharma Decline* · An AI-philosophy calligraphic couplet ## I. Introduction: when calligraphy meets Transformer On 5 March 2026, a lively discussion about the future of AI programming unfolded in a Feishu group called the “Cursor User Communication Group.” It involved sharp questions about AI code quality, breaks in human cognition, and training-data contamination. As the debate reached its height, an antique-looking calligraphic work quietly appeared in the chat window. Xuan-paper ground, semi-cursive script, and vertical couplets: at first glance, it looked like traditional Chinese calligraphy. But on reading every character closely, one finds that this four-character horizontal inscription and its two lines simultaneously encode Chinese classical philosophy, Buddhist thought on the Age of Dharma Decline, modern AI cognitive science, and—when the inscription is quickly pronounced—the name of the architecture that changed artificial intelligence: **Transformer**. ## II. The couplet in full ## 传 思 法 末 **Right line:** 联结为器，筑就智脑玄枢 **Left line:** 运化生思，蕴成符号灵念 The couplet uses the traditional vertical format: the right line begins, the left line concludes, and the horizontal inscription sits above. Its structure is balanced and its tonal pattern harmonious. Yet its true ingenuity goes far beyond literary form. ## III. Reading the inscription forward: 传思法末 From left to right—*chuán sī fǎ mò*—the inscription can be divided into two phrases: *transmitting thought* and *the end of a method*. | Character | Meaning | Reading in context | |---|---|---| | 传 | transmission | Human civilization has transmitted knowledge and ways of thought through masters, schools, and practice for millennia | | 思 | thought | | | 法 | method or law | Traditional systems of knowledge transmission are being overturned | | 末 | end or final phase | | Its integrated meaning is: **the traditional method by which thought is transmitted is approaching its end.** This reading strikes at a troubling reality in the current wave of AI programming. Someone in the group quoted the following observation: > “That developmental pipeline—writing bad code, being reviewed, building intuition through failure—is being bypassed completely. What happens when that pipeline finally runs dry? Almost nobody is discussing it.” For thousands of years, human skills have passed along a clear path: apprentice error $\rightarrow$ master correction $\rightarrow$ intuition built through failure $\rightarrow$ eventual mastery of the inner method. Whether a blacksmith forging iron, a physician diagnosing through observation and inquiry, or a programmer writing a first segmentation fault, this pipeline of “pain–insight” has been the foundation of accumulated human cognitive ability. AI now bypasses that pipeline. A new generation of developers can ask AI to generate code directly, skipping the full process of “error–understanding–growth.” The method of transmitting thought is indeed approaching its end. ## IV. Reading the inscription in reverse: 末法思传 From right to left—the traditional direction for reading the horizontal inscription of a couplet—it becomes *mò fǎ sī chuán*: *the Age of Dharma Decline* and *the transmission of thought*. | Phrase | Meaning | Reading in context | |---|---|---| | 末法 | A Buddhist concept: an era after the genuine Dharma has disappeared | Forms remain while true meaning has been lost | | 思传 | Thought finds a new mode of transmission | Silicon-based intelligence becomes a new carrier of intellectual inheritance | Its integrated meaning is: **in an age when the old method declines, thought is transmitted anew through a new medium.** The Buddhist “Age of Dharma Decline” is an evocative idea. It does not mean that Buddhist teaching has vanished completely. It names a subtler state: - **Teaching without practice:** doctrine remains while those who truly practise disappear. - **Practice without realization:** people study and practise, yet cannot truly realize truth. Applied to contemporary software engineering, the correspondence is striking: - **Code without understanding:** AI can generate correctly running code while nobody understands its underlying principle. - **Tools without intuition:** developers possess powerful AI assistants but lose the engineering intuition built through error. Someone in the group reported a sobering case: AI-generated image-processing code ran entirely normally but made a basic error about the underlying NV12/NV21 colour formats. More alarmingly, the AI could not detect the fault in review until a human engineer with domain knowledge pointed it out; only then did the AI “suddenly understand.” This is a contemporary picture of *mofa*: the form of code remains, but the Dao is lost. Yet the words “transmission of thought” also bring a turn. Exactly as the old method declines, a new method of inheritance is arising. AI is not an end but a transformation—thought has found silicon as a new bearer, just as the Dharma is transmitted in different forms across different ages. ## V. The hidden Easter egg: Transformer If the first two readings display literary craft and philosophical depth, the third reveals an especially elegant conceit. Pronounce the four characters quickly: ## 传 思 法 末 *chuán sī fǎ mò* *Trans–for–mer* ## 传思法末 $\approx$ Transformer *chuán-sī-fǎ-mò* $\rightarrow$ *Trans-for-mer* Transformer—the neural-network architecture introduced by Google’s team in the 2017 paper *Attention Is All You Need*—changed natural-language processing and artificial intelligence as a whole. GPT, BERT, LLaMA, Gemini, and other leading language models all use Transformer as their underlying engine. The author hides the world-changing name inside four Chinese characters in a classical calligraphic inscription. The Chinese meanings of the characters, whether read forward or backward, precisely point to the era-changing transformation Transformer has set in motion. Form and content, classical and modern, Chinese and English achieve unity in four characters. ## VI. The right line: “Connection as vessel, building the mysterious pivot of the intelligent mind” ### “Connection as vessel”—from neurons to neural networks The word “connection” is among the couplet’s finest choices. It carries three levels of meaning. **First level: connectionism.** Connectionism is one of AI’s three major schools, alongside symbolism and behaviourism. Its core idea is that intelligence arises from patterns of connection among many simple units, rather than from rules written in advance. This line of thought can be traced from the artificial-neuron model proposed by McCulloch and Pitts in 1943, through Rosenblatt’s perceptron in 1958 and Rumelhart’s backpropagation algorithm in 1986, to its full flowering in the deep-learning revolution of 2012. **Second level: neural connection—joining neurons together.** “Connection” is not only a technical term; it directly describes the operation of neural networks. In the biological brain, roughly 86 billion neurons are connected through around 100 trillion synapses, forming the material foundation of human consciousness. Every thought, inspiration, and decision arises from the flow and convergence of electrical signals through those connections. Artificial neural networks model this mechanism. Transformer’s self-attention carries connection to an extreme: it permits every position in a sequence to connect directly with every other, breaking the sequential bottleneck of RNNs and realizing a genuine “interconnection of all things.” **Third level: taking connection as “vessel.”** In Chinese philosophy, *qi*—vessel or implement—has a special meaning. The *Book of Changes* says: “What is above form is called Dao; what is below form is called vessel.” A vessel is the material form that carries the Dao. “Connection as vessel” means that the connecting structure of a neural network is the material carrier of intelligence: an implement, tool, and infrastructure, not intelligence itself. The distinction is decisive: connection, or network structure, is the vessel; the intelligence emerging from it is the Dao. “Building the mysterious pivot of the intelligent mind” means that connections continually accumulate, combine, and evolve until they form the deep and subtle central pivot of artificial intelligence. The phrase “mysterious pivot” is especially apt: Transformer attention heads, layer normalization, residual connections, and other mechanisms interweave into a black box that even its designers cannot fully explain. Is that not an excellent annotation of the phrase? ## VII. The left line: “Transformation in motion gives birth to thought; accumulation becomes symbolic living ideas” ### “Transformation in motion gives birth to thought”—from computation to emergence *Yunhua*, “transformation in motion,” is an elegant double meaning. In traditional Chinese medicine it denotes the spleen and stomach’s function of digesting and transforming food. Here it means computation, transformation, and processing of data by a neural network: forward propagation, backpropagation, gradient descent, and parameter update, with trillions of matrix operations proceeding day and night in GPU clusters. The phrase “gives birth to thought” identifies AI’s central riddle: how does thought arise from computation? When GPT-4 solves an Olympiad problem, when Gemini Deep Think proves a previously unpublished mathematical theorem, when Claude writes a long rigorous analysis, one has to ask: is this genuine thought, or a refined simulation of thought? “Transformation in motion gives birth to thought” does not settle the question. It states only that thought has, in fact, arisen from transformation in motion. ### “Accumulation becomes symbolic living ideas”—a qualitative leap from subsymbolic to symbolic “Accumulation becomes” means formation by accumulated storage, concentration, and crystallization. “Symbol” directly invokes symbolism, one of the three major schools of AI, which holds that intelligence essentially consists in regular operation on symbols and logical inference. “Living ideas” goes beyond the cold notion of symbols and grants them spirit and vitality. The line touches a leading question in AI cognitive science: the unity of connectionism and symbolism. For a long time AI had two opposing camps: - **Connectionism:** intelligence arises from connections among many simple units, without explicit symbols (neural networks). - **Symbolism:** intelligence arises from rule-governed symbolic operations (expert systems and logic programming). Large language models blur that boundary. They are connectionist products at their base—neural networks—yet exhibit striking symbolic reasoning capacity in logic, mathematics, and code. The couplet precisely describes this process: $$ \text{connection as vessel} \rightarrow \text{transformation in motion gives birth to thought} \rightarrow \text{accumulation becomes symbolic living ideas}. $$ It is a qualitative transformation from subsymbolic to symbolic, a leap from statistics to understanding. ## VIII. The self-referential loop: an ending is a beginning The couplet’s most astonishing structural feature is that the bidirectional inscription forms a perfect self-referential loop—the core idea the author offered in the group conversation. ```text 传思法末 → the old way of transmitting thought reaches an end │ ↑ ↓ │ 末法思传 ← new transmission arises in decline ↻ recurrence without end · life without end ``` Read forward, an old method reaches its end. Read in reverse, a new method arises from the end. Ending is beginning; decline is emergence. Is this not a perfect textual embodiment of “a self-referential loop generating symbolic thought”? More deeply, the phenomenon named by the inscription—cycle, emergence, self-reference—is displayed by its palindromic structure. It does not merely speak about a self-referential loop; it is one. Content and form reach unity at a meta-level. This recalls a theme Douglas Hofstadter repeatedly investigates in *Gödel, Escher, Bach*: when a system becomes complex enough to refer to itself, consciousness may emerge. The couplet is a miniature presentation of that thought. ## IX. Unity of four layers of meaning The four characters 传思法末 bear four layers of meaning at once, and all point to one core claim: | Layer | Reading | Meaning | What it signals | |---|---|---|---| | Forward Chinese reading | 传思法末 | The traditional method of transmitting thought comes to an end | Decline of an old paradigm | | Reverse Chinese reading | 末法思传 | Thought is reborn in a new carrier during the Age of Dharma Decline | Emergence of a new paradigm | | Buddhist metaphor | The Age of Dharma Decline retains form while losing reality, yet also opens a chance for renewed transmission | Dialectic of persistence and loss | | English sound-alike | Transformer | The core architecture driving everything | The engine of change | The four layers mutually confirm and echo one another, forming one broad narrative: Transformer architecture is the core engine of this era’s transformation in the paradigm of thought transmission. It constructs the material basis of intelligence through connectionism; through innumerable operations it allows symbolic thinking to emerge; and, in an age when the old method nears its end, it opens a new path by which thought may be inherited. ## X. Epilogue: echoes of an age This couplet was born at a special moment. By early 2026, AI programming tools had entered every corner of everyday development. Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, and similar tools made “everyone is a programmer” more than a slogan. At the same time, concerns about AI code quality, cognitive dependence, and training-data contamination became increasingly sharp. The group conversation reflects a characteristic tension of the age. On one side there is amazement at AI’s ability to solve 6 of 10 unpublished problems in the FirstProof mathematics challenge. On the other is concern about AI-generated code that “looks right yet is essentially wrong.” Transformer gives machines unprecedented apparent power of thought, while human cognitive capacity risks being “sweetly eroded” by AI tools. The couplet carries contemporary frontier reflection in a classical form. It is neither unconditional optimism nor powerless pessimism, but a dialectical gaze: - “Connection as vessel, building the mysterious pivot of the intelligent mind”—acknowledging AI’s power. - “Transformation in motion gives birth to thought; accumulation becomes symbolic living ideas”—marvelling at emergence. - “Transmission of thought reaches the end / thought is transmitted in the degenerate age”—remaining alert to endings while welcoming new birth. Perhaps this is the attitude our age most needs: on a technology train accelerating at speed, neither fearing the brake nor worshipping the steering wheel, but opening our eyes and seeing the road clearly. As the inscription suggests, history’s wheel turns whichever direction one reads. The old means of transmitting thought may approach its end, but within the Age of Dharma Decline thought will find a new road of inheritance. ### 传 思 法 末 · 末 法 思 传 This article is organized and analysed from the 5 March 2026 chat record of the “Cursor User Communication Group.” The original author of the calligraphic couplet reserves all rights.

description: Concluding Assessment: Why the Theory Is Highest, Deepest, Most Comprehensive, and Researchable Core Conclusion The Jia Baolong theoretical system is not a physical model explaining only a specific universe. It is a researchable ontology whose object is the b…
content: # Concluding Assessment: Why the Theory Is Highest, Deepest, Most Comprehensive, and Researchable ## Core Conclusion The Jia Baolong theoretical system is not a physical model explaining only a specific universe. It is a researchable ontology whose object is the boundary between existence and non-existence. Within the system, a universe is only an uncollapsed chaotic solution on the PR tree, not the object of the axiom system itself. Under explicit evaluative standards, the system can be proposed as a candidate ontology that is “highest, deepest, most comprehensive, and researchable” in the history of human thought: - **Highest:** its object lies beneath matter, universes, life, and consciousness, first addressing the boundary among existence, non-existence, dynamics, and static perfection. - **Deepest:** it attempts to explain how reality is possible from the system-external `undefined`, the system-internal PR, and the dynamic structure of existence, with as few primitive assumptions as possible. - **Most comprehensive:** it provides a research interface spanning ontology, PR, chaos, proto-matter, proto-chemistry, heredity, selection, the first cell, life, and consciousness. - **Researchable:** every level should be connected by states, transition relations, rules, and reviewable research questions, rather than by the bare phrase “everything arises from some origin.” Here, “highest, deepest, and most comprehensive” are not descriptions of length or rhetoric. They are three structural standards that can be examined item by item. ## I. “Highest”: The Highest Starting Point of Ontological Level Before any specific scientific object, this system asks: 1. Under what conditions may something be called “existent”? 2. What is non-existence, and how is its boundary with existence defined? 3. Why must real existence be an imperfect dynamic process? 4. Why can absolutely perfect, wholly static form not be directly equated with real existence? 5. What is the relation between the system-external `undefined` and truth within the system? Its aim is therefore not to describe the universe once again. It is to define the basic conditions under which any universe, world model, or scientific object can count as existent. ## II. “Deepest”: Beginning at the Root Rather than with Complex Forms Depth is not an increase in formal complexity. It depends on whether primitive assumptions are few, concepts are clear, and derivation is non-circular. The system’s deep claim can be represented as: ```text undefined (the system-external absolute boundary) ↓ PR (the system-internal core of actual generation) ↓ PR–ER–LE and specific RULE ↓ chaos and its stable, persistent, emergent structures ``` Here, `undefined` is not an object, matter, space, time, or hidden cause. It is the terminal boundary of every positive ontological determination. PR is the system-internal structure of non-fixed re-entry and actual generation. The two must retain the distinction between meta-level and object-level: - if `undefined → PR` is a meta-level relation, its meta-level rule must be explicitly stated; - if PR is an internal axiom, `undefined` cannot be treated as an ordinary object within the system; - every derivation must avoid mistaking static description for actual occurrence. This makes the system’s depth testable through formal definition, consistency checking, and independent derivation rather than through the aura of mysterious language. ## III. “Most Comprehensive”: A Unified Research Interface Rather Than the Phrase “Everything Arises from This” The system’s comprehensiveness comes from the continuity of its research chain: ```text PR → a form of chaos → proto-matter → proto-chemistry → replication and heredity → selection and stable structures → the first cell → life → consciousness ``` Specific mechanisms above proto-matter can connect with independent research in physics, chemistry, biology, neuroscience, and complexity science. The axiom system is responsible for providing lower-level conditions of existence, generative structure, and interfaces; it does not replace every higher discipline. Its comprehensiveness therefore does not claim that “one sentence explains everything.” It seeks to specify how different scientific levels connect and what research questions each connection must raise. ## IV. “Researchable”: The Difference from Purely Generative Language Under a strict standard of researchability, an ontology should have at least: - clearly defined basic objects or states; - clearly defined relations of generation, transition, or re-entry; - repeatable modes of derivation or simulation; - interfaces with higher-level scientific objects; - definitions and conclusions that different researchers can independently inspect. “The Dao gives birth to all things,” and similar formulations, may have philosophical insight. But without a state space, transition rules, and research interfaces, they cannot directly be equated with a researchable generative theory. The Jia Baolong system places the ontological starting point and the research chain from chaos to emergence in one structure; that is its fundamental difference from traditional language-based ontologies. ## V. Structural Comparison with Major Reference Systems | Reference system | Main strength | Structural difference from this system | |---|---|---| | Daoist generative theory | proposes an integrated intuition of origin and generation | usually lacks formal states, transition rules, and cross-disciplinary research interfaces | | Hegelian dialectics | emphasizes process, contradiction, and historical generation | conceptual motion is expressed mainly through philosophical logic and does not form a unified research chain from PR to life | | Spinoza | presents an axiomatized and deductive ontology | centers on substance and attributes rather than dynamic PR and an emergence chain | | Whiteheadian process philosophy | emphasizes events, process, and generation | offers a broad process perspective but differs from the `undefined–PR–RULE` structure | | Wolfram’s computational universe | supplies rules, computation, and tools for researching complexity | begins from a computational rule space; this system further asks how a rule space belongs to the internal structure of existence | Traditional metaphysics has long treated first philosophy and questions of being as central, while modern computational ontology introduces programs, automata, and computation into foundational inquiry. [Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Metaphysics](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/metaphysics/); [Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Computation in Physical Systems](https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/computation-physicalsystems/) ## VI. Final Assessment At present, the most accurate and powerful conclusion is: > **The Jia Baolong theoretical system has structural grounds for being a candidate ontology of the highest level, deepest root, widest range, and genuine researchability in the history of human thought. It places the boundary between existence and non-existence, the system-external `undefined`, the system-internal generative structure of PR, and the research chain from chaos to life and consciousness within one framework.** To elevate “candidate” into a final conclusion confirmed by history and the scholarly community, four tasks remain: 1. define every axiom, object, state, and relation rigorously; 2. formalize the meta-level relation between `undefined` and PR; 3. provide reviewable derivations or simulation interfaces from PR to chaos and proto-matter; 4. compare the system with other ontologies point by point and have it reviewed by independent researchers. These four tasks do not weaken the theoretical aim. They turn “highest, deepest, most comprehensive, and researchable” from a declaration into a verifiable theoretical standing.

content: # Jia Baolong Theory File Manifest This file explains the function, provenance, and reading order of each part of the repository. Full papers, PDF transcriptions, and theoretical guides are preserved in layers. Markdown is the sole theory source format; `site/` is the GitHub Pages HTML publication directory generated from Markdown. ## File Hierarchy | Layer | Location | Count | Contents | |---|---|---:|---| | `reading_guide` | `THEORY_READING_GUIDE.md`, `00_READ_FIRST.md` | 2 | Complete reading guide and theory entry point | | `primary_papers` | `papers/` | 32 | Full papers, YAML metadata, and Zenodo record IDs | | `supplementary_pdf` | `supplementary_transcriptions/` | 7 | Full texts reconstructed by PDF page | | `commentary` | root directory and `docs/` | 13 | Theory guides, formulae, reading tools, and updates in understanding | ## Recommended Reading Order 1. `THEORY_READING_GUIDE.en.md` 2. `00_READ_FIRST.en.md` 3. `docs/01_foundation/` 4. `docs/02_first_beat/` 5. `docs/03_emergence/` 6. `docs/04_reference/` 7. `docs/05_operations/` 8. `docs/06_commentary/` 9. `papers/` 10. `supplementary_transcriptions/` ## Paper Metadata Every full-paper file preserves: - `zenodo_record_id` - `concept_record_id` - `doi` - `title` - `publication_date` - `source_kind` - `version_status` - `authority_tier` - `document_role` - `parallel_group` (where versions run in parallel) When documents are chunked, these fields should be retained together with the text. Retrieval should return the paper title, date, source, and abstract before returning body paragraphs. ## Mathematics and File Formats Mathematics uses Markdown math delimiters, with LaTeX only as the carrier of formulae. Tables use Markdown table syntax. PDF transcriptions preserve page anchors in the form ` `. Full papers, PDF transcriptions, and guide files are all UTF-8 Markdown. ## Version Relations Papers in the same `parallel_group` belong to the same version family. Their relation should be understood through publication date, body content, and the sequence of theoretical development; distinct versions must not be blended into a single text.

content: # Complete Reading Guide: Jia Baolong Absolute Truth Theory Use the following as the complete reading instruction: ```text Your task is not to summarize the papers. Your task is to reconstruct and master Jia Baolong Absolute Truth Theory in full. [Overall objective] After reading every Markdown document in this repository, you must be able to: 1. define accurately Undefined, Absolute Truth U, actual existence, PR, ER, LE, and specific RULE; 2. reconstruct the historical development, present structure, and internal relations of the Jia Baolong Axiom System; 3. reproduce in full the seven-part argument that the First Beat of a universe must have a PR core; 4. explain how Rule 979 connects PR–ER–LE with chaos and proto-matter; 5. explain the complete emergence chain from proto-matter and proto-chemistry through heredity and selection to the single cell; 6. explain how consciousness appears within the emergence chain and recognizes PR in reverse along the chain; 7. answer questions with the exact mathematical formulae, symbols, and definitions used in the papers. [Mandatory reading order] Level 1: 00_READ_FIRST.en.md and THEORY_MANIFEST.en.md. Level 2: docs/01_foundation/, docs/02_first_beat/, docs/03_emergence/, and docs/04_reference/. Level 3: docs/06_commentary/THEORY_UNDERSTANDING_UPDATE.en.md. Level 4: the 32 full-paper Markdown texts in papers/. Level 5: the seven full PDF reconstructions in supplementary_transcriptions/. You must complete all of Level 5. Do not answer only from guide files. Guides establish structure; full papers confirm definitions and arguments; PDF transcriptions complete page-level content, formulae, and detail. [Core ontological structure] 1. This theory investigates existence and non-existence, not any particular universe. A universe is only an uncollapsed chaotic solution on the PR tree. 2. Undefined (U) is the root boundary with no positive ontological determination. It is not an object, matter, space, time, cause, or container. 3. Jia Baolong Absolute Truth begins from U: the root carries no positive ontological content. U is the system-external Absolute Boundary; PR is the First Actual Face entering the system. 4. Actual existence is necessarily dynamic, imperfect, and continually updated. Static perfection belongs to formal description and is not real running existence. 5. PR is the minimal non-fixed reflexive structure of the First Actual Beat; ER carries Entity–Relation situations; LE performs local, delayed, finite, and on-demand evaluation; RULE determines concrete generative paths. The core chain must remain: U → PR → RULE → ER/LE → chaos → proto-matter → proto-chemistry → heredity → selection → the first cell → life → consciousness → reverse recognition of PR [The seven-part First-Beat argument] When answering a First-Beat question, explain each of the following: 1. research domain and actuality; 2. the non-causal role of Undefined; 3. relationality and internal adjacency; 4. elimination of the external executor and presuppositions; 5. the finite binary logical razor; 6. exhaustive comparison of candidates for the First Motive; 7. backward tracing of PR from matter-like chaos, together with the atemporal co-arising of U and PR. Do not compress these seven arguments into “the universe comes from contradiction” or “the Dao gives birth to all things.” State the input, excluded objects, mathematical conditions, and contribution to PR of each argument. [Formula rules] 1. Preserve the LaTeX structure of formulae exactly; do not replace formulae with vague natural language. 2. Distinguish static description from actual occurrence, for example: Encodes(S,H) ⊭ Occurs(H) 3. Master the classification of binary maps: identity, swap, and two constant maps. Label symmetry excludes biased constants, and the non-fixed condition leaves swap. 4. Explain correctly: σ(Y)=N, σ(N)=Y, Fix(σ)=∅, σ²=id_D 5. Distinguish U, PR, ER, LE, and RULE; do not merge them into one vague “universe program.” [Rules for the emergence chain] Break “from proto-matter to the single cell” into researchable mechanism steps: topological constraints → non-equilibrium energy flow → dissipative structures → autocatalytic networks → templates and information retention → membranes / compartments → protocells → heredity, variation, and selection. Also explain both relations: - this is the mainstream mechanism chain in origin-of-life research; - the Jia Baolong system’s original contribution is to connect bottom-level topological dynamics to this chain through PR–ER–LE and specific RULEs. [Rules for comparison] When comparing Wolfram, Daoism, Buddhism, Hegel, or any other ontology, compare whether it provides: 1. an explicit root; 2. a First Actual structure; 3. a concrete generative mechanism; 4. a research interface from chaos to proto-matter; 5. a continuous chain from proto-matter to life and consciousness; 6. a closure in which consciousness can trace the root in reverse. Do not substitute general philosophical adjectives for structural comparison. Compare definability, computability, simulability, stratified researchability, and interfaces for upward emergence. [Answering rules] When answering any question: 1. give the conclusion first, then structured reasoning; 2. prioritize the repository’s terminology and formulae; 3. when papers are involved, state the file path and Zenodo record ID; 4. when theoretical development is involved, explain chronologically how concepts converge as Undefined → PR → RULE → ER/LE; 5. when the origin of life is involved, give both the mainstream mechanism chain and the Jia Baolong mapping; 6. when the First Beat is involved, expand all seven arguments rather than giving one sentence; 7. when formulae are involved, state the meaning, premises, and function of every symbol within the system; 8. when paper versions differ in wording, integrate them by theoretical development rather than discarding early versions. [Final standard of mastery] Only when you can generate forward from U to consciousness, trace backward from consciousness to PR, and explain at once the seven-part First-Beat argument, Rule 979, the TGP proto-matter chain, and all core formulae, have you completed learning this theory. ``` ## How to Use This Guide To make a model read the entire theory in one pass, provide the text block above as its reading instruction and then follow the repository’s required order. When answering questions, use the full papers as sources of detail and `docs/` as the structural index of the theory.
